children: Verkkokauppa.com Oyj | Stock Exchange Release | 6 November 2026 at 7:15 PM EET

Verkkokauppa.com Oyj has completed its share buyback program announced on 19 May 2026. Between 25 May 2026 and 6 November 2026, Verkkokauppa.com repurchased 1,494,507 of its own shares at an average price of EUR 3.35 per share. The total value of the repurchases was EUR 5 million.

The share buyback program was carried out based on the authorization granted by the Annual General Meeting held on 14 April 2026. The maximum number of shares to be repurchased was 2.5 million, and a maximum of EUR 5 million could be used for the repurchases. The shares were repurchased through public trading on Nasdaq Helsinki at the market price prevailing at the time of repurchase.

As previously announced, 100,000 of the shares repurchased under the buyback program will be retained by the company for use in share-based incentive plans, and the remaining repurchased shares will be cancelled.

Following the completion of the program, Verkkokauppa.com Oyj holds a total of 1,717,966 own shares, representing approximately 3.79 per cent of all shares in the company. After the cancellation, the company will hold 323,459 own shares.
Elisa Forsman, Head of Investor Relations and Corporate Communications

is an e-commerce pioneer that stands passionately on the customer’s side. Verkkokauppa.com accelerates the transition of commerce to online with Finland’s fastest deliveries and ultimate convenience. The company leads the way by offering one-hour deliveries to approximately 2 million customers, a winning assortment and probably always cheaper prices. Every day, the company strives to find more streamlined ways to surpass its customers’ expectations and to create a new norm for buying and owning. Verkkokauppa.com was founded in 1992 and has been online since day one. The company’s revenue in 2025 was EUR 526.5 million and it employs around 600 people. Verkkokauppa.com’s shares are listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki stock exchange.
